scope: Theorem 8.1 of the manuscript “The Margulis–Platonov conjecture over number fields” (preprints/The-Margulis-Platonov-conjecture-over-number-fields-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 018 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 545dc0b02e847a4c), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 66. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let k be a number field and let G be an absolutely almost simple simply connected k-group of type D4, including the trialitarian forms. Every noncentral abstract normal subgroup of G(k) is G(k).
